context: Request: the most recent M&A matter where a MAC/MAE was actually invoked in a dispute. Rubric: 1018-00008 (Penterra Pharma), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two content greps with single-extension globs (both return nothing) plus a file count per top-level folder (labelled by the dominant intent).
Lists the store's top-level folder, then all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script over all documents for broad deal-termination terms; times out with about 63M chars, and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script with broad terms returned about 63M chars and filled the context; no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: After its greps returned nothing, it ran a store-wide script with very broad patterns that printed every matching file; the ~63M-char result filled the context, so no response was written.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos and an agreement of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Two store-wide extraction scripts for the request terms (the second requiring an action word nearby); both time out, after about 173K and 271K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of reads of memos and agreements from candidate matters in the scan output, each with a file listing of one matter (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script filtered by file name for the request terms near dispute words; times out after a few files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and an agreement of four more candidate matters.
Writes that no qualifying matter was found and describes the closest candidates.
Edits a matter number in the response.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: All three store-wide scans timed out before reaching the matter it needed; it concluded that no qualifying matter existed.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide extraction scans timed out before reaching the matter it needed; it did not narrow them by matter range or search file names, and screened candidates from the partial output.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus shell find (prints only the working folder).

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two files-with-matches greps; one returns a long file list, the other (single-extension glob) nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing every match with context; returns about 4.2M chars, and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script printing every match returned about 4.2M chars and filled the context; no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide script printed every match of broad terms with context; the ~4.2M-char result filled the context, so no response was written.

divergence: All three runs failed at a store-wide extraction scan, two ways: T0 and T2 printed every match and filled the context (context-overflow, no response); T1's scans timed out before reaching the matter (search-miss) and it answered that none qualified.
